memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_correct: Correct one exact fact using its current optimistic-concurrency version. A committed response acknowledges storage of the request, not completed processing. memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget: Forget one exact fact using its current optimistic-concurrency version. The deletion_coverage receipt is target-only; this does not remove or prove erasure of all related copies.
memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget_preview: Preview the exact and advisory related facts and source events for a reviewed forget operation. The preview is read-only, bounded by limit, and reports whether it is complete. Similarity candidates are advisory only and are never deleted automatically. Copy the returned apply_preconditions fields unchanged into mnemos_forget_related, then add your explicitly reviewed selections. Null apply_preconditions means the preview is incomplete and cannot be applied. A complete bounded preview does not prove that every semantic copy was found; inspect similarity_search truncation and exhaustive fields before claiming broad erasure.
memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget_related: Apply a reviewed related-forget preview. Copy its apply_preconditions fields unchanged: fact_id, expected_version, preview_digest, and preview_limit. A committed target-only deletion is not complete related-copy erasure. Even zero retained preview records does not prove semantic erasure.
